# mergewf_skill_enablement (Resource)

Enables or disables a Merge-managed global skill and manages its complete reach. Destroy disables the skill for this organization. Import using its slug.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "mergewf_skill_enablement" "example" {
  slug       = "merge-example-skill"
  is_enabled = true
  scope      = "ORG"
  group_ids  = []
  person_ids = []
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `is_enabled` (Boolean) API field `is_enabled`.
- `slug` (String) API field `slug`. Minimum length: 1.

### Optional

- `group_ids` (List of String) API field `group_ids`. Omit to accept the server value; use an explicit empty collection to clear a collection.
- `person_ids` (List of String) API field `person_ids`. Omit to accept the server value; use an explicit empty collection to clear a collection.
- `scope` (String) API field `scope`. Omit to accept the server value; use an explicit empty collection to clear a collection. Who an organization reaches with an enabled global skill: everyone, some Groups, or named people. Allowed values: `ORG`, `GROUP`, `PERSON`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identity. See the resource description for its import format.
- `result_json` (String) Complete API response encoded as JSON. Use jsondecode to access additional response fields. Stored in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import mergewf_skill_enablement.example SKILL_SLUG
```
